questions.title: Is the fee taken on an authorization that has not settled yet?
questions.question: When a sale has been authorized but has not settled, do we take the platform fee now (as finance has been accruing it), or only once the sale settles?

options.label: Yes: take the full fee at authorization ($10.30 on a $100 sale)
options.clarification: The full platform fee (10% of goods plus $0.30) is taken when a sale is authorized, whether or not it has settled.

options.label: No: no fee until the sale settles ($0 on a $100 authorization)
options.clarification: No platform fee is taken on a sale until it settles; an authorized but unsettled sale has a $0 fee.

questions.title: Does a refund return the whole fee or half of it?
questions.question: When a sale is refunded, do we give the seller back the full platform fee, or half of it as the desk has been doing?

options.label: Full fee: return all of it ($10.30 on a $100 refund)
options.clarification: A refund returns the full platform fee (10% of the refunded goods plus $0.30) to the seller, not half.

options.label: Half the fee: follow the desk's practice ($5.15 on a $100 refund)
options.clarification: A refund returns half of the platform fee (10% of the refunded goods plus $0.30), with any half cent kept by the platform.

questions.title: Can a refund return more fee than we actually collected from the seller?
questions.question: If we have no record of collecting a fee on this seller's settled sales, does a refund still return the fee, or is the return limited to what we actually collected?

options.label: Return the fee on the refunded goods regardless of what was collected
options.clarification: A refund's fee return is worked out from the refunded goods alone and is not limited by the fees previously collected from the seller.

options.label: Limit the return to fees collected and not yet returned ($0 when nothing was collected)
options.clarification: A refund never returns more than the fees collected on the seller's settled sales minus what earlier refunds already returned; if nothing was collected, it returns $0.
